headline_item.title_zh: OpenAI发布GPT-6.2模型提示词优化指南
headline_item.title_en: OpenAI shares new prompting tips for GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol to fix brief answers and unnecessary questions
headline_item.event_summary_zh: OpenAI发布针对Astra与Sol模型的提示词模版，旨在解决回复过于简略及过度询问的问题，并更新API以支持舍弃推理过程数据
headline_item.event_summary_en: OpenAI released new system prompt templates for the GPT-6.2 model family, specifically Astra and Sol, to mitigate excessive brevity and repetitive clarification queries. The update includes API modifications allowing developers to discard internal reasoning traces, ensuring final outputs are self-contained for end-users.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】OpenAI在开发者文档及模型API接口：发布提示词模版及API更新，旨在优化模型回复风格、主动性及输出质量
【起因与机理】解决模型在复杂任务中回复冗余、过度依赖推理过程记录及交互逻辑滞后的问题
【关键技术规格】针对Astra（高性能）与Sol（高性价比）模型发布标准化提示词模版。
【各方立场与态度】调整模型行为预期，要求在具备授权前提下主动采取行动而非被动询问确认。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] OpenAI: Issued prompt templates and API updates to optimize response style and agency
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To address issues with excessive brevity, reasoning leakages, and hesitant agent behavior
[Key Metrics] Through the API, Astra costs $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens.
[Key Position & Outlook] Shifted model behavior to favor autonomous execution over confirmation-seeking loops.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 模型向更高效的推理及任务自动执行演进时，如何通过Prompt约束强制模型脱离‘推理链式思考（CoT）’惯性是当前应用层优化的关键。此举反映了OpenAI试图解决大模型作为Agent时因过度谨慎导致的‘交互磨损’，通过系统级设定将模型输出与思维链路彻底解耦，是提升复杂业务流自动化效率的必然路径。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: The transition to agentic workflows requires decoupling final outputs from internal Chain-of-Thought (CoT) traces to prevent response degradation. OpenAI's move highlights the industry struggle with agent 'interaction friction,' where reducing model latency and cognitive burden is now as critical as scaling model performance.

headlines.title_zh: DeepMind聘任哲学家以应对AGI意识挑战
headlines.title_en: Google DeepMind’s Henry Shevlin: ‘This is the most important part of being human’
headlines.event_summary_zh: 剑桥大学学者Henry Shevlin加入Google DeepMind，负责研究AI意识、人机关系及通用人工智能就绪性
headlines.event_summary_en: Henry Shevlin, former associate director at the Leverhulme Centre for the Future of Intelligence, has joined Google DeepMind as an in-house philosopher. He is tasked with researching machine consciousness, human-AI ethics, and AGI readiness to address growing public and academic concerns regarding existential risks and AI autonomy.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Henry Shevlin（Google DeepMind哲学家、前剑桥大学学者）在Google DeepMind内部研究团队：负责机器意识、人机交互伦理及AGI发展准备度评估
【起因与机理】针对AI领域日益增长的安全性担忧及对AI意识觉醒的理论探索需求
【核心事实细节】Google DeepMind扩容伦理研究团队以应对AGI发展中的认知科学风险。
【核心诉求与态度】大型科技公司正通过制度化引入跨学科专家来回应AI安全性与生存威胁争议。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Henry Shevlin (Google DeepMind Philosopher): Leading research on machine consciousness and AGI social readiness
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Addressing intensifying safety concerns and the philosophical implications of AI development
[Key Fact Detail] Google DeepMind expands ethics research to address AGI-related cognitive risks.
[Key Position & Outlook] Tech firms are institutionalizing interdisciplinary oversight to manage AI safety concerns.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 头部大模型厂商通过高薪吸纳哲学与伦理学者，本质上是将社会契约与安全性验证前置于技术路径中，以缓解监管压力。此举反映了AI研发重心已从单纯的性能指标迭代，转向对认知边界与主体性风险的防御性治理，试图在AGI爆发前建立“合规护栏”的知识体系。
headlines.industry_impact_en: By integrating philosophers into core research teams, tech giants are proactively internalizing ethical compliance to mitigate regulatory scrutiny. This shift signifies that AI development is moving beyond raw performance scaling toward establishing robust conceptual frameworks for AI safety and autonomy governance.

headlines.title_zh: 黎曼猜想证明引发AI与人类数学家角力
headlines.title_en: Hours after Anthropic claims a Claude proof of the Riemann hypothesis, Stanford releases an all-human competing draft
headlines.event_summary_zh: Anthropic数学家Levent Alpöge声称利用Claude证明了黎曼猜想，随后Stanford学者发布人类独立证明草案
headlines.event_summary_en: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge announced a proof for the Riemann Hypothesis using the Claude model, utilizing simulated derivatives. Shortly after, Stanford math professor and AMS president Ravi Vakil released an independent, human-only draft proof by Alessandro Masullo, emphasizing the exclusion of AI assistance.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Levent Alpöge (Anthropic)、Alessandro Masullo (斯坦福大学研究员)、Ravi Vakil (美国数学会主席)：Alpöge通过AI辅助提出证明方案；斯坦福团队发布纯人工验证草案
【起因与机理】AI在高端数论推演中的介入引发了学界关于“AI辅助证明”有效性与学术主权的竞逐
【核心事实细节】数学界核心课题黎曼猜想成为AI证明效力的“压力测试”场景。
【各方立场与态度】学术界以纯人工草案对冲AI产出，凸显数学证明中的伦理与权属争议。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Levent Alpöge (Anthropic), Alessandro Masullo (Stanford), Ravi Vakil (AMS President): Alpöge presented an AI-assisted proof; Stanford released a purely human-authored competing draft
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Rising tension over the validity and attribution of AI-assisted mathematical proofs
[Key Fact Detail] The Riemann Hypothesis serves as a stress test for AI-assisted mathematical reasoning.
[Key Position & Outlook] Academia counter-positions human-authored work against AI output, intensifying attribution debates.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 黎曼猜想证明权的争夺战本质是AI原生科学发现与传统学术范式的权责碰撞。人类学者通过“抢发”纯人工草案重申数学研究的解释权与可追溯性，这凸显了在基础科学高地，由于AI幻觉风险与“黑箱”逻辑，学界对大模型输出结果的信任度依然处于极低水平。
headlines.industry_impact_en: The competing claims on the Riemann Hypothesis highlight a friction between AI-native scientific discovery and traditional academic paradigms. The rapid release of a human-only proof underscores the academic community's deep skepticism toward AI-assisted results, driven by concerns over hallucination and the 'black box' nature of LLM reasoning.
